verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of Mistral's developer docs. Document AI pages are also served as raw markdown (e.g. /studio/document-processing/overview.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs for this product. missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or Document-AI-specific agent docs, first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, independent or community corroboration of agent use.
